_notes: Curated business-profile data per ticker, loaded by build.py and rendered in the stock detail Read More panel. Inspired by screener.in company pages. Add new tickers as needed; all fields optional.

highlights.title: Manufacturing Facilities
highlights.text: Operates 30 manufacturing units, including 22 in Paonta Sahib (HP), 2 in Haridwar (UK), and 2 in Udaipur & Behror (Rajasthan).

highlights.title: PAN India Presence
highlights.text: 16,000+ field force, 13,000+ stockists, 75 CFAs, reaching 5,00,000+ doctors and a vast chemist & pharmacy network across India.

highlights.title: Exports
highlights.text: Exports to USA (major market), Sri Lanka, Nepal, Chile, Kenya and others.

highlights.title: Exports Portfolio
highlights.text: 42 products in US portfolio; 1 new product launched in Q3FY25 and 4 in 9MFY25.

highlights.title: R&D Initiatives
highlights.text: 6 R&D centres; spent INR 233 Cr (~2.1% of FY24 revenue). Focus on biotechnology, sustainability and a GPR119 agonist NCE for obesity/diabetes - Phase 1 complete, Phase 2 planned.

highlights.title: BSV Acquisition
highlights.text: Acquired the branded generic women's health portfolio from subsidiary Bharat Serums & Vaccines (slump sale, INR 797 Cr, two installments).

MANKIND.NS.focus: Consolidate market share via deeper penetration in high-value CVM and chronic therapies, supported by volume-led growth and brand scaling. Expand into super-specialty and complex portfolios via acquisitions and in-licensing. Strengthen presence in metros and Tier-I cities and grow consumer healthcare. Continued investment in digital platforms, AI/ML productivity tools, and R&D for high-entry-barrier pipeline.

highlights.title: Diversified Conglomerate
highlights.text: Operates across Oil to Chemicals, Retail, Digital Services, and New Energy sectors, forming a highly diversified business portfolio.

highlights.title: Market Leadership
highlights.text: Jio Platforms is India's largest telecom operator by subscribers, and Reliance Retail is India's largest retailer by revenue and store count.

highlights.title: New Energy Push
highlights.text: Investing heavily in green energy initiatives, including solar, batteries, and hydrogen, with significant manufacturing capacities under development.

highlights.title: Integrated O2C Operations
highlights.text: Operates one of the world's largest and most complex integrated refining and petrochemical complexes at Jamnagar, India.

highlights.title: Strategic Investments
highlights.text: Continuously expanding through organic growth and strategic acquisitions in key sectors like retail, digital technology, and new energy.

RELIANCE.NS.focus: Reliance Industries is focused on accelerating its transition into new energy businesses, while continuing to expand its leadership in India's retail and digital services sectors. The company aims to leverage its integrated ecosystem to drive sustainable growth and enhance shareholder value through strategic investments and operational excellence.

highlights.title: Merger
highlights.text: Completed the merger with Housing Development Finance Corporation (HDFC Ltd.) in July 2023, significantly expanding its loan book and customer base.

highlights.title: Branch Network Expansion
highlights.text: Continuously expanding its physical branch network, particularly in semi-urban and rural areas across India, to enhance accessibility and deepen market penetration.

highlights.title: Digital Transformation
highlights.text: Investing heavily in digital banking initiatives, including mobile banking, online platforms, and payment solutions, to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

highlights.title: Asset Quality
highlights.text: Maintains a strong focus on asset quality and risk management, consistently reporting lower non-performing asset (NPA) ratios compared to industry averages.

HDFCBANK.NS.focus: HDFC Bank's forward strategy centers on leveraging its expanded scale post-merger to drive growth across retail and wholesale segments. The bank aims to deepen its presence in underserved markets through branch expansion and digital outreach, while maintaining a strong emphasis on asset quality and technological innovation to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

highlights.title: 5G Rollout
highlights.text: Bharti Airtel has rapidly expanded its 5G network across India, aiming for pan-India coverage.

highlights.title: Digital Services Expansion
highlights.text: The company is increasingly focusing on digital services, including cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, and data center solutions for enterprises.

highlights.title: Infrastructure Sharing
highlights.text: Bharti Airtel utilizes its passive tower infrastructure segment (Indus Towers) to provide services to other operators, generating additional revenue.

highlights.title: African Market Presence
highlights.text: Airtel Africa, a subsidiary, is a prominent telecommunications and mobile money services provider across 14 countries in Africa.

BHARTIARTL.NS.focus: Bharti Airtel is focused on enhancing its 5G network capabilities and expanding its digital services portfolio to drive growth in both consumer and enterprise segments. The company aims to improve average revenue per user (ARPU) in India through premiumization and maintain strong growth in its African operations, particularly in mobile money services.

highlights.title: Market Leadership
highlights.text: State Bank of India is the largest bank in India by assets, deposits, branches, and employees.

highlights.title: Digital Transformation
highlights.text: Significant investment in digital banking platforms like YONO (You Only Need One) to enhance customer experience and expand reach.

highlights.title: Subsidiaries & Diversification
highlights.text: Operates various subsidiaries in areas like life insurance, general insurance, asset management, and credit cards, contributing to diversified revenue streams.

highlights.title: Rural & Agricultural Focus
highlights.text: Extensive branch network and focus on agricultural and rural banking, supporting financial inclusion across India.

SBIN.NS.focus: State Bank of India is focused on leveraging its extensive network and digital capabilities to drive growth in both retail and corporate segments. The bank aims to enhance customer experience through technological innovation, expand its reach in underserved markets, and maintain asset quality while supporting India's economic growth.

highlights.title: Digital Transformation
highlights.text: Significant investment in digital platforms like 'iMobile Pay' and 'InstaBIZ' to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

highlights.title: Subsidiary Performance
highlights.text: Strong contributions from its insurance subsidiaries, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance and ICICI Lombard General Insurance.

highlights.title: Asset Quality Improvement
highlights.text: Consistent improvement in asset quality with declining net non-performing assets (NPAs) over recent years.

highlights.title: Branch Network Expansion
highlights.text: Continued expansion of its physical branch network, particularly in semi-urban and rural areas of India, alongside digital initiatives.

ICICIBANK.NS.focus: ICICI Bank's strategy is centered on leveraging its digital capabilities to expand its customer base and enhance service delivery across retail and corporate segments. The bank aims to maintain strong asset quality while focusing on profitable growth, supported by its diversified business model including its successful insurance ventures.

highlights.title: Global Presence
highlights.text: TCS operates in over 55 countries, serving a diverse global client base.

highlights.title: R&D and Innovation
highlights.text: Significant investment in R&D, focusing on AI, cloud, IoT, and cybersecurity, leading to a strong portfolio of proprietary platforms and products.

highlights.title: Talent Pool
highlights.text: One of the largest IT services employers globally, with a strong focus on talent development and reskilling.

highlights.title: Strategic Partnerships
highlights.text: Collaborates with leading technology vendors and hyperscalers to enhance its service offerings and market reach.

TCS.NS.focus: TCS is focused on driving digital transformation for its clients by leveraging its deep industry expertise, proprietary platforms, and a strong portfolio of next-generation technologies. The company aims to expand its market share in key growth areas like cloud, AI, and cybersecurity, while continuing to innovate and deliver value across its core service lines.

highlights.title: Product Diversification
highlights.text: Offers a wide array of financial products including consumer finance, personal loans, home loans, gold loans, and SME loans.

highlights.title: Digital Transformation
highlights.text: Significant investment in digital platforms and mobile applications to enhance customer acquisition and service delivery.

highlights.title: Geographic Reach
highlights.text: Extensive presence across India with a large network of branches and digital touchpoints.

highlights.title: Parentage
highlights.text: A subsidiary of Bajaj Finserv Ltd., benefiting from the strong brand reputation and financial backing of the Bajaj Group.

BAJFINANCE.NS.focus: Bajaj Finance aims to continue its growth trajectory by expanding its customer base, particularly in underserved segments, leveraging digital innovation for efficient operations and customer experience, and maintaining a diversified product portfolio to mitigate risks and capture various market opportunities within India's growing financial services sector.

highlights.title: Manufacturing Capacity
highlights.text: Operates 11 manufacturing facilities across South India, with a total cement capacity of 21 million tonnes per annum (MTPA).

highlights.title: Power Generation
highlights.text: Engaged in power generation from windmills and thermal power plants, contributing to captive power needs.

highlights.title: Product Diversification
highlights.text: Expanded product portfolio beyond cement to include ready mix concrete and a range of construction chemicals.

highlights.title: Logistics Network
highlights.text: Utilizes a strong logistics network including railway sidings and a large fleet for efficient distribution.

RAMCOCEM.NS.focus: The Ramco Cements Limited is focused on expanding its manufacturing capacities, optimizing operational efficiencies through captive power generation, and strengthening its market presence in South India. The company also aims to grow its value-added product portfolio, including ready-mix concrete and construction chemicals, to cater to evolving construction demands and enhance profitability.

highlights.title: Platform Model
highlights.text: Operates an online marketplace connecting consumers with service professionals for home and beauty services.

highlights.title: Service Offerings
highlights.text: Provides a wide range of services including cleaning, pest control, appliance repair, plumbing, carpentry, painting, and various beauty and wellness treatments.

highlights.title: Brand Expansion
highlights.text: Sells proprietary products like water purifiers and electronic door locks under its 'Native' brand.

highlights.title: Professional Training
highlights.text: Offers training and certification programs for service professionals to ensure quality and skill development.

highlights.title: Geographic Reach
highlights.text: Presence in India, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Singapore, and the United Arab Emirates.

URBANCO.NS.focus: Urban Company's strategy is centered on expanding its service categories and geographic footprint, enhancing the quality and standardization of its service professionals through training, and leveraging its 'Native' brand for product sales to deepen customer engagement and diversify revenue streams. The company aims to solidify its position as a leading home and beauty services marketplace by continuously improving its technology platform and user experience.

highlights.title: Broadcasting Reach
highlights.text: Operates a vast network of satellite television channels in multiple regional languages including Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, and Bangla.

highlights.title: Content Diversification
highlights.text: Offers a wide range of content genres including general entertainment, movies, music, news, and kids programming.

highlights.title: Sports Franchises
highlights.text: Owns and operates two cricket franchises: SunRisers Hyderabad in the Indian Premier League (IPL) and Sun Risers Eastern Cape in the South Africa Premier League.

highlights.title: Digital Presence
highlights.text: Operates SUNNXT, an Over-The-Top (OTT) platform, to cater to the growing digital viewership.

highlights.title: Print Media
highlights.text: Engages in the publication of daily newspapers and magazines, complementing its electronic media presence.

SUNTV.NS.focus: Sun TV Network is focused on strengthening its leadership in regional language broadcasting by investing in compelling content and expanding its digital footprint through the SUNNXT OTT platform. The company also aims to leverage its sports franchises for brand visibility and revenue diversification, while exploring new opportunities in media and entertainment.

highlights.title: Diversified EPC Portfolio
highlights.text: KPIL offers comprehensive EPC services across power transmission & distribution, railways, buildings & factories, water, oil & gas, and urban infrastructure sectors.

highlights.title: Global Presence
highlights.text: The company has a significant international footprint, executing projects in over 70 countries across Africa, Middle East, Asia, and CIS regions.

highlights.title: Strategic Acquisitions
highlights.text: KPIL has expanded its capabilities and market reach through strategic acquisitions, such as the acquisition of Fasttel, strengthening its railway electrification business.

highlights.title: Strong Order Book
highlights.text: Maintains a robust order book providing revenue visibility for the coming years, driven by infrastructure development globally.

KPIL.NS.focus: Kalpataru Projects International Limited is focused on leveraging its diversified EPC expertise to capitalize on global infrastructure spending, particularly in renewable energy transmission, railway modernization, and water infrastructure. The company aims to enhance its international presence and operational efficiencies while selectively pursuing opportunities in high-growth sectors.

highlights.title: Manufacturing Capabilities
highlights.text: Operates multiple manufacturing facilities across India, including Chennai, Baddi, Manesar, and Bengaluru, with advanced SMT lines and cleanroom facilities.

highlights.title: Acquisitions
highlights.text: Acquired SGS Tekniks in 2021, significantly expanding its manufacturing footprint, customer base, and product portfolio in electronic manufacturing services.

highlights.title: R&D Focus
highlights.text: Strong emphasis on in-house R&D for product design, development, and value engineering, particularly in areas like RFID, custom magnetics, and power solutions.

highlights.title: Diverse End Markets
highlights.text: Serves a wide range of industries including automotive, industrial, healthcare, consumer electronics, and IT, reducing dependency on any single sector.

SYRMA.NS.focus: Syrma SGS Technology aims to expand its market share in the electronic manufacturing services (EMS) sector by leveraging its integrated design and manufacturing capabilities. The company is focused on increasing its wallet share with existing customers and acquiring new clients across high-growth industries, while also exploring strategic acquisitions to enhance its technological offerings and geographical reach.

highlights.title: Brand Portfolio
highlights.text: Operates hotels and cruisers under the luxury 'Oberoi' and upscale 'Trident' brand names.

highlights.title: Diversified Services
highlights.text: Beyond hotels, also operates Oberoi Flight Services, Oberoi Airport Services, restaurants, lounges, and provides air charter and car rental services.

highlights.title: Strategic Partnership
highlights.text: Has a long-standing strategic alliance with Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group for global sales and marketing.

highlights.title: Property Ownership
highlights.text: Engages in renting of investment properties, complementing its core hospitality operations.

EIHOTEL.NS.focus: EIH Limited is focused on expanding its luxury and upscale hotel portfolio, both domestically and internationally, while enhancing its service offerings in flight catering and airport services. The company aims to leverage its strong brand reputation to capture growth in the premium hospitality sector and optimize returns from its existing asset base.

items.label: Hot Rolled Coils, Sheets, and Plates

highlights.title: Product Offerings
highlights.text: Offers hot rolled coils, sheets, and plates, including specialized grades for welded steel pipes, structural steel, silicon steel, and LPG cylinders.

highlights.title: Industry Focus
highlights.text: Serves key industries such as infrastructure and construction, automotive and mobility, energy (oil and gas), and engineering and fabrication.

highlights.title: Incorporation
highlights.text: Incorporated in 2015, indicating a relatively modern operational setup within the Indian steel industry.

NSLNISP.NS.focus: NMDC Steel Limited is focused on leveraging its integrated steel plant to cater to the growing demand across various industrial sectors in India. The company aims to optimize its product mix to serve critical infrastructure, automotive, and energy projects, enhancing its market position within the domestic steel industry.

items.label: Silver, Diamond & Platinum Jewellery, and other products

highlights.title: Retail Network Expansion
highlights.text: Thangamayil Jewellery has been consistently expanding its retail footprint, primarily in Tamil Nadu, India, with a focus on tier 2 and tier 3 cities.

highlights.title: Product Diversification
highlights.text: While primarily focused on gold, the company has been increasing its offerings in diamond, silver, and platinum jewellery to cater to a broader customer base.

highlights.title: Gold Saving Schemes
highlights.text: The company offers various gold saving schemes, which help in customer retention and provide a steady stream of advance payments for future purchases.

highlights.title: Online Presence
highlights.text: Thangamayil Jewellery has an online presence, allowing customers to browse and purchase products digitally, complementing its physical store network.

THANGAMAYL.NS.focus: Thangamayil Jewellery's strategy is centered on expanding its retail network within South India, particularly in Tamil Nadu, to capture a larger share of the organized jewellery market. The company aims to enhance its product portfolio with a focus on design innovation and customer-centric gold saving schemes, while also leveraging its online platform for broader reach.
